page_title: SAL 1-2 ATA | Salernitana v Atalanta 06/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Ermano Feliciani has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
90+3' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 9:17.
90+3' Looks like Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
90+2' A player from Atalanta commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
90+1' Atalanta quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
88' A great run from Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) ends with a shot inside the box that flashes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
87' The corner by Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.

86' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick.
85' The linesman raises his flag. El Bilal Toure (Atalanta) is adjudged offside.
84' Substitution. El Bilal Toure (Atalanta) in, Ademola Lookman out.
83' Good defending. Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) tries to find Ademola Lookman inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gianluca Scamacca trots off the pitch and is replaced by Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta).
77' Domagoj Bradaric is being substituted because of an injury. Stefano Colantuono sends Andres Sfait (Salernitana) on the pitch.
77' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
75' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) rises above the defence and heads a precise cross towards the left post. His effort, however, is blocked by Vincenzo Fiorillo, who pulls off a stunning save!
74' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) took the corner.
72' Hans Hateboer (Atalanta) wins the ball from the corner kick and strikes. The effort lacks accuracy and goes miles wide of the left post.
71' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

71' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Atalanta.
70' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) has an effort from close range after latching on to a precise pass, but he can't beat one of the defenders who makes a good block.
69' Stefano Colantuono prepares a substitution. Emanuel Vignato is replaced by Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana).
69' The substitution is prepared. Alessandro Zanoli (Salernitana) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Junior Sambia.
69' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Salernitana.
67' Some patient build-up play from Atalanta as they look to unlock the defence.

63' 1 - 2 What a beautiful moment! Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the bottom left corner. Vincenzo Fiorillo just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:2.
63' Atalanta take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

63' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) controls a cross inside the box and sends a shot towards the left post, but one of the defenders reacts superbly to block his effort. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Atalanta.
60' Substitution. Shon Weissman (Salernitana) on for Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi.
57' 1 - 1 Gooal! Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) scores with a shot from inside the box after latching onto a headed pass from Mario Pasalic. He makes it 1:1.
57' Atalanta work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
57' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
56' Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle and signals a foul after Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) brought his opponent down.
54' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) tries to find Charles De Ketelaere, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
52' Hans Hateboer (Atalanta) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
50' The opposition can't get near Ademola Lookman (Atalanta), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the left post at the last second.
49' Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana) attempts to convert the resulting set piece, but his miskick only goes way over the crossbar. A poor shot!
48' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) makes a slide tackle, but referee Ermano Feliciani blows for a foul. Salernitana have a free kick from a promising distance.
48' Emanuel Vignato (Salernitana) produces a long-range volley, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.

47' Emanuel Vignato (Salernitana) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the left post is, however, superbly saved by Marco Carnesecchi!
46' Stefano Colantuono decides to make a substitution. Triantafyllos Pasalidis will be replaced by Marco Pellegrino (Salernitana).
46' Half-time substitution. Ederson (Atalanta) will not participate anymore and Teun Koopmeiners is coming on.
46' Gian Piero Gasperini makes a half-time substitution. Matteo Ruggeri comes on in place of Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta).
46' Half-time substitution. Gian Piero Gasperini decided to make a change. Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) is replaced by Charles De Ketelaere.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Triantafyllos Pasalidis (Salernitana) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

45+3' Aleksey Miranchuk plays a pass to Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta), but he fails to get a decent shot away from inside the box and the ball goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Salernitana will have a goal kick.
45+2' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
45+1' Triantafyllos Pasalidis (Salernitana) takes out his opponent with a nasty challenge and is relieved when the referee only gives him a booking.
45' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.

42' Federico Fazio (Salernitana) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle for an infringement. Atalanta earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
41' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) sends a long ball forward to Ademola Lookman, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The linesman signals a throw-in for Salernitana.
38' Triantafyllos Pasalidis (Salernitana) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Atalanta in a dangerous position.
37' A long pass, executed by Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta), missed the precision to reach his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Salernitana.
35' Salernitana take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

34' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his shot towards the left post, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it. The ball goes out of play. Salernitana are awarded a corner kick.
33' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Toma Basic (Salernitana). Ermano Feliciani saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
32' Atalanta have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
31' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
29' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
28' Great teamplay by Atalanta as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
26' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) commits a foul during an attacking move.
23' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) does well to meet a cross from Gianluca Scamacca, but he directs his shot just wide of the left post.
20' PENALTY APPEAL by Salernitana, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
20' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Ermano Feliciani to decide it wasn’t offside. The relieved Salernitana players can finally celebrate.
19' Wait! Referee Ermano Feliciani has indicated he is going to review the Salernitana goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

18' 1 - 0 Goal! Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Emanuel Vignato inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
15' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) covers his face with his hands after wasting a glorious chance. The ball rebounded to him but his close-range header went a whisker wide of the left post.
15' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
14' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.

11' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball has crossed the sideline. Salernitana are taking a throw-in.
8' Junior Sambia (Salernitana) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it high over the bar.
7' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) homes in on a magnificent reverse pass from Mario Pasalic and strikes a crisp shot goalwards that just misses the left post.
6' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
3' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) tries to find Gianluca Scamacca, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
2' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Ademola Lookman.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Salernitana will have the kick-off.
Ermano Feliciani was nominated as the referee for this game.
